name: Claim the Price
body:
Claim the Price (Su) [Any Lord of Evil]
Source Mythic Origins pg. 11
Whenever an adjacent enemy confirms a critical hit against you, you can expend two uses of your mythic power to imprint some of your blood on that creature and force it to carry out some action or course of activity, as determined by you. This effect is similar to that of a lesser geas spell, but can affect any creature with fewer Hit Dice than your character level plus your mythic tier. Creatures with mythic ranks or tiers equal to or greater than your mythic tier are unaffected by this ability.
